products.eligibility_rules: Available to Australian citizens or permanent residents residing in Australia with a valid Medicare card; also to temporary residents with a valid Medicare card or compliant Australian private health insurance and a valid visa beyond return, holding a return ticket and normally residing in Australia. Trip must start and end in Australia. Policy must be purchased before departure unless buying while already overseas and meeting strict conditions (been overseas <14 days or continuously insured with lapse ≤14 days; age ≤65; Australian citizen/permanent resident; valid Medicare; trip ends in Australia; declared already overseas; insurer agrees and notes status).
products.age_eligibility_notes: General availability to ages up to 89 at purchase. Purchase while already overseas only up to age 65 and subject to a 48-hour no-cover period and a $500 excess. Optional Adventure and Motorcycle Packs available only if aged ≤74.

waiting_period_rules.benefit_or_section: Policies purchased while already overseas (all benefits)
waiting_period_rules.exceptions: COVID-19 Benefits 27 and 28 have a 72-hour no-cover period
waiting_period_rules.evidence: p11-b9 to p11-b10; p7-b8 to p7-b10

waiting_period_rules.trigger: First 48 continuous hours in hospital not payable
30 days from return home before weekly payments begin

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 25 days if trip hasn’t started and no rights used. If cancelled 26–366 days after purchase and trip not started: 60% refund (Basics 70%). No refund after trip has started. COVID-19 exception: full refund if unable to start trip due to a COVID-19 reason not covered by the policy (provided no other claim made).
products.excess_options: Excess chosen at purchase (one excess per event). Policies bought while already overseas have a fixed $500 excess and a 48-hour no-cover period. Some sections have $0 excess (e.g., Emergency Dental, Hospital Cash, Travel Delay, Personal Accident/PD).

excess_rules.amount_text: Chosen excess per claimable event (one excess per event)
excess_rules.evidence: p11-b19 to p12-b1; p99-b7 to p99-b8

excess_rules.basis: per claim (except where section excess already $0)

excess_rules.amount_text: $0 for Emergency Dental, Hospital Cash, Travel Delay, Personal Accident/PD

products.luggage_single_item_limit: Unspecified item sub-limits: computers/cameras $3,000; mobile phones/portable comms $1,500; tablets $1,000; any other unspecified item or set $750.
products.electronics_or_valuables_limit: Mobile phones $1,500 sub-limit; stand-alone computers/cameras/video recorders $3,000; tablets $1,000 (within total luggage limit).
products.personal_accident_limit: Accidental Death up to $25,000 (age bands apply); Permanent Disability up to $50,000 (age bands apply).
products.loss_of_income_limit: Up to $400 per week, maximum 26 weeks (max $10,400)
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID-19 medical, hospital and medevac overseas covered (Benefit 27). Trip cancellation/disruption up to $5,000 per adult if you test positive ≥72 hours after purchase, are denied boarding, fail entry due to a positive test, are directed to isolate, or a close relative in Australia is hospitalised in critical condition or dies from COVID-19. No cover for border closures, lockdowns or general travel restrictions; no cover for close contact unless the positive case is named on the Certificate; no cover for COVID-19 tests except during hospitalisation.

cruise_benefits.limit: Must be selected to cover claims arising on a cruise
cruise_benefits.conditions: Required for 1+ night cruises within Australian waters/NZ/South Pacific; required for 4+ nights in Asia/Europe/Worldwide; river cruises do not require cruise cover.
cruise_benefits.exclusions: General Exclusion 47 applies if cruise cover not selected (except FTS policy)

optional_add_ons.age_rules: Driver’s licence and rental car conditions apply

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless noted, limits apply per insured person per trip. Single and Family cover types share combined limits across listed travellers (Family limits are double Single for most benefits). Duo travellers have Single limits each (except Rental Vehicle Excess).
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: No cover for any medical or pregnancy condition existing within 3 years before policy issue or arising/changed after issue and before departure unless disclosed, screened and listed as covered on the Certificate (additional premium may apply). After departure, new conditions cannot be added. Close relative conditions have strict criteria. Changes in health after purchase automatically exclude listed conditions unless re-screened and re-approved before departure.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Covers unexpected serious complications of pregnancy and childbirth up to end of 23rd week (single) or 19th week (multiple). No cover for childbirth (unless listed complications and listed as covered), newborn care, or antenatal care/medications. Pregnancy conditions within 3 years before policy issue or changes after issue require screening and written listing to be covered.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cancellation/disruption cover for Close relatives in Australia only if strict ‘Close relative conditions’ are met (independent living, not awaiting treatment, no recent hospitalisations, not terminal, age ≤84). If not met, cover limited to 25% of non-refundable expenses up to $2,000. Age ≥85 close relatives excluded from such claims.

included_activities.conditions: Kokoda expeditions not automatic (Adventure Pack required)

included_activities.activity: Recreational bicycling and tours with licensed operator (not racing/BMX/downhill)

optional_activity_cover.conditions: With licensed operator; ropes and safety gear; no free solo
OW licence or licensed instructor; cruise cover required for certain overnight cruise durations
Single rider, max one passenger; no jumping/racing

excluded_activities.scope: Excluded even with Adventure or Bicycle Pack

excluded_activities.exclusion: Motocross, jumping, racing or competition of any sort
excluded_activities.scope: Excluded even with Adventure or Motorcycle Pack
Excluded even under Snow Sports Plus

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Only covers the rental company’s insurance excess up to the selected limit; rental must have damage/theft insurance; driver must hold appropriate Australian licence (Provisional or higher) and any required local licence; excludes motorcycles/mopeds/scooters; documentation from rental company required. No cover if breach of rental agreement, DUI, unlicensed, learner’s licence use, or ineligible vehicle types.
products.luggage_conditions: No cover for items left unsupervised or in public places; do not leave valuables in checked baggage; use hotel safe/locker; no overnight storage in unattended vehicles; daytime vehicle theft limited and only if locked/obscured with forced entry; thefts to be reported within 24 hours; IMEI must be provided and blocked for phone claims.

depreciation_rules.item_category: Toiletries (cosmetics, skincare, perfume, hair products, medications)
Computers and electrical devices (PCs, cameras, video recorders, mobiles, tablets, electronics)
Clothing, shoes, luggage, books (incl. prescription/sun glasses)

general_exclusions.name: Travel restrictions and government actions
general_exclusions.description: No cover for border closures, lockdowns/lockouts or other travel restrictions; or detentions/confiscations by authorities; or prohibition/embargo/sanctions.
general_exclusions.evidence: p5-b7 to p5-b9; p92-b8 to p92-b12; p96-b11 to p96-b15

general_exclusions.name: Do Not Travel warnings
general_exclusions.description: No cover where DFAT ‘Do Not Travel’ advice applies after purchase and you did not take reasonable action to avoid/minimise loss.

general_exclusions.name: Financial collapse of providers
general_exclusions.description: No cover for insolvency/financial collapse of travel agents, carriers, tour or accommodation providers.

general_exclusions.name: Motorcycle/moped use without Motorcycle Pack and licence/helmet requirements
general_exclusions.description: No cover unless Motorcycle Pack purchased and licence/helmet and road-use conditions are met.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover contrary to UN/AU/EU/UK/US sanctions; no cover for travel to Cuba, Iran, North Korea; no cover if DFAT ‘Do Not Travel’ advice (post-purchase) not heeded; Antarctica/war/terrorism/nuclear/chemical exclusions apply as per General Exclusions.
products.claims_process_summary: Notify medical claims as soon as possible; emergency assistance 24/7. Other claims: submit online/email with full details within 30 days of return. Provide police/carrier reports within 24 hours for theft/misplacement where reasonably possible, receipts/proof of ownership, medical reports, and rental documents where relevant. Insurer processes claims within 10 business days of receiving complete information.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 Emergency: In Australia (02) 8320 7999; Overseas +61 2 8320 7999; emergency@fastcover.com.au. Must contact if hospitalised, for evacuations (prior approval required), and for outpatient treatment expected to exceed $2,000.
products.premium_factors: Policy type, traveller age, destination/region, trip length, time between purchase and departure, covered medical/pregnancy conditions, selected options/add-ons (cruise, Adventure/Motorcycle/Bicycle Packs), chosen excess.

cruise_benefits.limit: Automatically included for FTS (no need to select cruise)
cruise_benefits.conditions: Standard cruise conditions on claim scenarios apply

optional_add_ons.name: Spouse & Dependants cover (FTS)
optional_add_ons.availability: Optional for Frequent Traveller Saver only
optional_add_ons.changes: Extends FTS to accompanying spouse/partner and dependants for 100% of itinerary; combined policy limits apply

products.limit_basis_notes: Per person per journey unless otherwise noted. FTS limits re-apply per journey as per policy structure; family add-on shares combined policy limits as specified.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: As per policy: pre-existing conditions in last 3 years require screening and listing; changes in health after issue and before each trip start must be disclosed and re-screened to maintain cover.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Complications up to 23/19 weeks with exclusions; pre-existing pregnancy conditions require screening/listing; childbirth/newborn care excluded.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Close relative conditions and 25%/$2,000 limitation if not met; relatives ≥85 excluded from such claims.

excluded_activities.scope: Excluded under FTS (no specific snow benefits)
excluded_activities.evidence: p22-t1 shows No Cover for Benefits 20–23 under FTS

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: As per policy for rental insurance excess, licence, documentation, and exclusions.
products.luggage_conditions: As per luggage section: unsupervised/public place exclusions; vehicle theft limits; safe/locker usage; reporting; IMEI blocking.

general_exclusions.name: Provider insolvency
general_exclusions.description: No cover for travel service provider insolvency/financial collapse

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: As per General Exclusions (sanctions, DFAT advisories).
products.claims_process_summary: Claims to be lodged within 30 days of return; provide documentation; emergency assistance for medical/evacuations 24/7.
products.emergency_assistance_details: Emergency +61 2 8320 7999; evacuation and hospitalisation contact required; outpatient >$2,000 contact.
products.premium_factors: Age, destination/region selections, chosen maximum trip duration (15/25/40/63 days), add-ons (spouse & dependants, Adventure/Motorcycle/Bicycle, rental excess), chosen excess.

source_evidence.quote: Frequent Traveller Saver ... unlimited number of Trips in a 12-month period up to a specified number of days (15, 25, 40 or 63 days).
Cover for travelling on a Cruise ship is automatically included with the Frequent Traveller Saver Policy.
FTS column shows medical/dental unlimited/$1,000; cancellation unlimited; travel delay $2,000; luggage $15,000; PD $25,000; Loss of Income $10,400; COVID-19 cancellation $5,000.
FTS ‘Benefit limit 76 to 89 years of age: Not available’ for medical—implies age limitations for FTS medical cover at higher ages.

products._notes: Cruise cover is automatically included on FTS. Optional spouse & dependants cover is available and shares policy limits. Benefit tables indicate medical benefits not available for ages 76–89 on FTS.

data._document_notes: Policy shows nuanced age and availability conditions by plan/benefit (e.g., FTS medical not available 76–89; Snow Sports Plus purchase age ≤69; already-overseas purchase available only for certain plans up to age 65). Single-trip maximum trip durations are not specified in the excerpt; only FTS durations are provided. Travel services provider insolvency appears excluded rather than a covered benefit.
